tools.name: compact
tools.description: Ask a session to summarise itself, then continue it in a new session file that points back at it. The old file is never changed except by the two turns this writes into it. With `brief_file` the brief is taken from that file instead, the old session is not asked and not written to at all, and the fork happens at its current tail — the path a driver takes when the model already handed off. Either way the carried text ends with a pointer back to the parent session. Returns the new session id.

session.description: The session to compact; it must not be running a step.

focus.description: Extra emphasis for the brief. Supplements the required sections, never replaces them. Ignored with brief_file.

max_steps.description: Steps the summarising run may take (1-3, default 1). Ignored with brief_file.

brief_file.description: Path (workspace-relative or absolute) to a brief that already exists. Given, the old session is left byte-identical and only the fork happens.
